QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Lazy, Lazy Tess
QuestInfo.0: Go see Tess by the Altaire Barrier Stone on the left side of the camp.
QuestInfo.1:
You must destroy Tree Rods and collect #e#b50 #t4000438##k#n items for the camp.
You can find Tree Rods in #m300020000# and #m300020100#.
QuestInfo.2: You collected 50 of #t4000438# items and delivered them to Tess.

0.0: Hey there, Kao. You can do me a favor, right?

yes.0: As you know, my duty is to keep Altaire Camp safe from the lurking horrors of this place, so I can't leave my post. However, I am in need of #bTree Trunks#k. Maybe about #b50#k of them? You will run into a lot of Tree Rods in #m300020000# and #m300020100#, so could you chop some up for me?

no.0: Kao, you've changed! How could you turn down my request? I'm...I'm hurt.

yes.0: Wow, this is great, Kao. Thank you so much! I will take these to Loha. Maybe now she'll get off my back about helping out... Ahem, thanks again!

item.0: You know what a #t4000438# looks like, right? Get them from the woodsy monsters in #m300020000# and #m300020100#.
